description: Flood Risk Zones is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Environment Agency. This dataset maps flood risk for London taken from the Environment agency's national dataset. Each cell is allocated one of four flood risk categories, taking into account flood defences and their condition. © Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2017. All rights reserved. Coverage: Environment Agency. The publisher named on the listing is Environment Agency. Its keywords include flood, zone, risk, plain. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
